description: Answer what's most popular or rising, as co.build/top ranks it: across all devices, for one kind of device (categoryId, from the returned categories) or for the user's devices (deviceIds). Top is what's most used and trusted, weighing real use, growth, conversation and who builds it; Rising is what's gaining fastest right now. Lists run short rather than pad. Each entry's traction shows the evidence behind its place: downloadsPerMonth counts release downloads, not installs; hackerNewsPosts counts recent Hacker News stories; strengths are relative 0-4 steps, not weights. The ranking is co.build's view of popularity, not a quality, compatibility or safety verdict: before recommending one, call compare_mods, or get_mod and get_feedback. Pass nextOffset as offset to continue. Cite the returned URLs.

categoryId.description: One kind of device, from categories. Omit for all devices.

deviceIds.description: Only mods for these catalog devices (IDs from search or get_device), each at its best place among them.

sort.description: top: most used and trusted. rising: gaining fastest right now.

name: get_top_mods

categories.description: Kinds of device with their own list; pass an id as categoryId.

count.description: Ranked mods for this kind of device.

device.description: The device it's ranked for here.

categoryRank.description: Its best place on a kind of device's list (get_top_mods categoryId); null when it isn't on one.

contributors.description: People with commits to its code.

downloadsPerMonth.description: Downloads of its latest release, as a 30-day rate. Downloads, not installs or users: auto-updates count too.

fit.description: How closely it's built for the device it's ranked for. device: made for that device; ecosystem: made for its platform; general: general software that runs on it; component: part of a larger project; null: not reviewed yet.

hackerNewsPosts.description: Hacker News posts linking it recently, with 10 or more points.

isNew.description: On today's Top list across all devices, but not the previous day's.

rank.description: Its place on co.build/top across all devices; null when it isn't on that list.

risingRank.description: Its place on Rising, what's gaining fastest across all devices; null when it isn't on that list.

since.description: The year its repository was created.

starHistory.description: GitHub stars over its life: running totals, oldest first, evenly spaced from the week of start to the week of end (YYYY-MM-DD).

starsGained.description: Net GitHub stars gained over the last `days` days.

strength.description: How much each signal lifts its place, 0 (none yet) to 4 (exceptional), relative to the most that signal can add. Not weights or scores. use: downloads, installs and stars; growth: stars gained; talk: people sharing it; builders: people building it.

topUrl.description: The co.build/top list it places on: all devices, else its kind of device's, else Rising; null when on none.

typicalStarsPerDay.description: New stars on a typical day of the last four weeks.

title: Rank the most popular and rising mods
